Both the reference file and the SKILL.md pointer are saved. My memory store is at 92%, so I'll skip adding to it — this lesson is fully captured in the skill reference, which is the right home for a procedural pattern.

Summary of what I saved:

The generalizable lesson — these "exactly N sources... how many calendar months exceeded threshold" questions are **piecewise-constant step-function counts, not monthly time series**. With only 2 survey sources covering a 24-month range, each survey value is held constant across a forward 12-month window (a Jan survey covers Feb–next Jan). You threshold-test each source value once, then sum the window lengths that pass — so the answer is a multiple of the window length (0/12/24), never an arbitrary cherry-picked count.

My error (7 vs gold 12): I treated the range as a real monthly series and read ~7 individual months, instead of recognizing one survey value exceeded $20000M and contributing its full 12-month window.

Saved to:
- references/sparse-source-month-window-count.md (full procedure)
- SKILL.md pointer at top of the reference-files list

This is genuinely new (no prior reference covered survey-attribution counting), so it's worth keeping.
